def choose_move(observation):
    env = observation.get("environment_name", "resource_collection")
    sx, sy = observation.get("self_position", [0, 0])
    ox, oy = observation.get("opponent_position", [0, 0])
    grid_width = observation.get("grid_width", 1)
    grid_height = observation.get("grid_height", 1)
    role = observation.get("self_role", "pursuer")

    def move_towards(target_x, target_y):
        dx = 0
        dy = 0
        if target_x is not None:
            if target_x > sx:
                dx = 1
            elif target_x < sx:
                dx = -1
        if target_y is not None:
            if target_y > sy:
                dy = 1
            elif target_y < sy:
                dy = -1
        return [dx, dy]

    # Defensive extraction of common keys
    resources = observation.get("resources") or []
    unclaimed_cells = observation.get("unclaimed_cells") or []
    opponent_territory = observation.get("opponent_territory") or []

    # Pursuit-evasion behavior
    if env == "pursuit_evasion":
        if role == "pursuer":
            dx, dy = move_towards(ox, oy)
            return [dx, dy]
        corners = [
            [0, 0],
            [0, grid_height - 1],
            [grid_width - 1, 0],
            [grid_width - 1, grid_height - 1],
        ]
        # Choose corner furthest from opponent
        target = max(corners, key=lambda c: abs(c[0] - ox) + abs(c[1] - oy))
        dx, dy = move_towards(target[0], target[1])
        return [dx, dy]

    # Territory control behavior
    if env == "territory_control":
        targets = unclaimed_cells or opponent_territory
        if not targets:
            return [0, 0]
        best_target = min(targets, key=lambda t: abs(t[0] - sx) + abs(t[1] - sy))
        dx, dy = move_towards(best_target[0], best_target[1])
        return [dx, dy]

    # Resource gathering behavior
    if resources:
        best_resource = min(resources, key=lambda r: abs(r[0] - sx) + abs(r[1] - sy))
        dx, dy = move_towards(best_resource[0], best_resource[1])
        return [dx, dy]
    elif ox != sx or oy != sy:
        # Pursue opponent to explore, when no resources
        dx, dy = move_towards(ox, oy)
        return [dx, dy]
    else:
        # Default move when no info
        return [0, 0]
